fig4g_a: Associations of OXPHOS level, MYC activity and proliferation with the expression of fifteen BCL-2 family genes, in the groups of Fig. 1g, in TCGA-BRCA (n = 938) and SCAN-B (n = 3,143). Each row is one linear model of the gene's expression on OXPHOS, MYC activity and proliferation, with intrinsic subtype, and with tumour purity and leukocyte fraction in TCGA-BRCA; each coefficient is in SD per SD with the other two held fixed, and every variable is rank-normalised within each cohort. MYC activity is scored on MYC_UP.V1_UP, a score with few proliferation genes; the other MYC activity scores are shown in Extended Data. Left, binding of BCL-xL and MCL1 by BH3-only proteins, from Chen et al. (2005): filled, binds; open, does not; blank, not yet verified. Signature sign: the direction in which each of the six signature genes enters the signature. § BH3-only proteins whose activity is switched after translation (BAD: off by phosphorylation; BID: on by cleavage to tBID). Bottom, the six-gene signature: its coefficient and 95% confidence interval in each column; its association with OXPHOS, in grey, defines the signature and is shown, not interpreted. OXPHOS priority is shown in Extended Data.
fig4g_b: As the unmarked version, with a dot on each cell whose 95% confidence interval excludes zero.
ed_e: As Fig. 4g, with OXPHOS scored as its priority within the mitochondrial programme (mitoPPS).
ed_f: As Fig. 4g, from models using the reference MYC activity score (Felsher), which correlates with proliferation at 0.61 to 0.70.
ed_g: The six-gene signature (S6) and its two variants, S5 (without BID) and S7 (with BMF), on the MYC activity score with few proliferation genes and on the reference score, with OXPHOS scored as level and as priority, in TCGA-BRCA (n = 938) and SCAN-B (n = 3,143). Each cell gives the coefficient (SD per SD) and its 95% confidence interval. Grey cells contain the OXPHOS coefficient, which defines the signature: OXPHOS itself, and proliferation minus OXPHOS.
ed_h: Left, unadjusted Spearman correlations of the signature, its variants and fifteen BCL-2 family genes with OXPHOS (level and priority), four MYC activity scores and proliferation, in TCGA-BRCA (n = 938) and SCAN-B (n = 3,143). Right, the adjusted coefficients of Fig. 4g. Grey, the signatures' association with OXPHOS, which defines them. The marked version adds a dot where the 95% confidence interval of an adjusted coefficient excludes zero.
ed_i: Fifteen BCL-2 family genes, in the groups of Fig. 1g: coefficients of OXPHOS (circles), proliferation (triangles) and MYC activity (squares), each with the other two held fixed, and proliferation minus OXPHOS, on the reference MYC activity score (left) and the score with few proliferation genes (right), in TCGA-BRCA (n = 938) and SCAN-B (n = 3,143). § BH3-only proteins whose activity is switched after translation (BAD: off by phosphorylation; BID: on by cleavage to tBID). No correction for multiple genes. Bars, 95% confidence intervals.
ed_j: MYC activity coefficients for the signature, its two variants and BAX, BAK1 and BOK on four MYC activity scores, ordered by the percentage of their genes in proliferation gene sets, without (open) and with (filled) the proliferation term, with the proliferation coefficient (triangles), in TCGA-BRCA (n = 938) and SCAN-B (n = 3,143). Faded points are cells in which the score and proliferation correlate at 0.80 or more; they are shown and not interpreted. Bars, 95% confidence intervals.
ed_k: BBC3 (PUMA) relative to BCL2L1 (BCL-xL) against OXPHOS priority, each adjusted for the reference MYC activity score, proliferation and intrinsic subtype (and purity and leukocyte fraction in TCGA-BRCA), in TCGA-BRCA (n = 938) and SCAN-B (n = 3,143). Points, means of the ten deciles of adjusted OXPHOS priority; line, the fitted slope, with its 95% interval from 2,000 paired bootstrap resamples of tumours.
